name: Drug Plasma Concentration
description: Steady-state plasma concentration of a drug in a closed-loop drug delivery system. Checks whether concentration stays within the therapeutic window.

elements.name: Steady-State Plasma Concentration
elements.description: Predicted drug plasma level at steady state. Uncertain due to patient-specific pharmacokinetic variability.

elements.name: Maximum Safe Plasma Concentration
elements.description: Upper bound of therapeutic window from clinical pharmacology

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(Dose_rate) = (Dose_rate · F_bioavail) / CL_patient; F = F_bioavail/CL (population PK parameter)
consistency_relations.upr_description: Steady-state plasma concentration is an affine function of infusion dose rate via the one-compartment PK model: C_ss = (Dose_rate · F) / CL. This parametric mapping propagates the dose rate uncertainty through the population pharmacokinetic parameters into the plasma concentration domain, where it must remain below C_max = 18 ng/mL.
